title: a-bulk-move-forwards-itself-from-gits-own-rename-record
owner: CC owns the code and the proofs. ONE THING IS NOT CC's AND IT IS NOT A BOUND BUT A QUESTION
intention: When the corpus moves in bulk, the forwarding that keeps every berthed packet's addresses resolvable is DERIVED from git's own rename record instead of authored one address at a time on a ticket.
why:
MEASURED 2026-08-14 by shaking the whole nest over the census. 307 findings stand across the corpus, and 306 of them are ONE CAUSE wearing three sieve names:

  survey_holdings_resolve   188 findings over 6 components
  constraint_traces          94 findings over 6 components
  charted_refs_resolve       24 findings over 7 components
  proofs_exist                1 finding  (unrelated — builder)

Behind those 306 findings are 130 DISTINCT addresses and 378 occurrences, and every one of them is a berthed packet naming a file at the layout the corpus had before the rung move (cairn/<name>/ -> cairn/{tools,machines,devices}/<name>/) and the chart dissolution (chart/ -> skills/chart/). Not one is a claim that was false when it was written. Each was true at berth time and the ground moved under it.

THE LIVED SYMPTOM, and it is not the count: build_inspector is the promotion gate. 306 standing findings mean that today, a component cannot be promoted without a reader hand-sorting real drift out of reorg residue — and the reader who does that sorting under time pressure is the reader who learns to skim the whole class. That is how a gate stops gating: not by being switched off, but by being right about so many things that nobody reads it. The gate's own founding failure was 'done' reported while the files stood unmoved (2026-07-24); a gate drowned in reorg residue cannot catch the next one.

AND THE MECHANISM ALREADY EXISTS AND IS ALREADY WRONG-SHAPED. `_forwarding_map` reads a `forwarding` order off the TICKET: `{from: {to, why}}`, authored by hand, checked at both ends. That shape is right for a deliberate single move a build makes on purpose. Aimed at a bulk reorg it asks a hand to type ~465 entries that git already recorded as it happened — and a hand-typed forwarding table is a second, hand-maintained copy of a fact the repository holds authoritatively. Law 1: re-deriving a settled answer is a defect, and this one is settled in the object store.

falsifier.proves_green: (1) DERIVE, DO NOT AUTHOR: the forwarding a bulk move needs is computed from `git log --diff-filter=R -M -C`, transitively followed, and confirmed against the file existing on disk NOW — a rename record whose target is gone forwards nothing. (2) A DIRECTORY IS A CONSENSUS OVER ITS FILES, not a new source: derived from the tracked files that were under it, and stated as such where a reader can see it. (3) THE HAND-AUTHORED ORDER SURVIVES AND KEEPS PRECEDENCE. `_forwarding_map` is right for a deliberate move a build makes on purpose, and it is the only thing that can speak for a DISSOLUTION (cairn/chart/intention+why.json went into skills/chart/, and no rename records that). Derivation fills the bulk; the ticket still says the things git cannot know. (4) THE DERIVATION IS MEASURED, NOT ASSERTED: whatever ships reports how many addresses it resolved and how many it did not, because the residue is the part a hand must then answer for.
falsifier.proves_red: DONE when a shake of the nest over the whole census reports the reorg residue as ZERO without any hand-authored entry for a moved-not-dissolved address, AND the two genuine dissolutions are named on a ticket by a hand. WRONG INTENT if: (1) the sieves are narrowed to stop reading old packets before Akien has ruled the invariant — that is answering his question by shipping; (2) the derivation is cached into a checked-in table, which recreates the hand-maintained second copy under a machine's name; (3) an address is forwarded to a target that does not exist on disk, which forwards a live reader into a hole — worse than the red it replaced; (4) the residue count is suppressed rather than reported, because the residue is precisely the set a hand still owes.
falsifier.horizon: The derivation is one build and it is small — the measurement above IS the prototype, and it ran in one pass over the repo. The disposition of the 306 is NOT one build and is not startable until the invariant is ruled.

questions.a: 306 FINDINGS, ONE CAUSE, THREE SIEVE NAMES. Read as a count, this looks like the corpus is in trouble in three different ways. Read by address, it is one bulk move seen from three angles. A gate that reports the same cause 306 times has a naming problem as well as a forwarding problem, and the second is not fixed by fixing the first.

NOT ONE OF THESE CLAIMS WAS FALSE WHEN IT WAS WRITTEN. That is what separates this whole class from the 2026-07-24 failure the sieves were built for. There, the claim was false at the moment it was made. Here, the claim was true and the world moved. The gate cannot currently tell those apart, and telling them apart is what the ruling above decides.

A HAND-AUTHORED FORWARDING TABLE IS A SECOND COPY OF A FACT THE REPOSITORY HOLDS. The mechanism is not wrong — it is right for the case it was built for (a deliberate move a build makes) and was reached for outside it. Aiming it at a bulk reorg asks a hand to re-derive what git recorded automatically, which is Law 1's defect with a data structure around it.

THE 82%/90% SPLIT IS THE ARGUMENT, NOT THE 100%. Derivation does not have to be complete to be right. It has to cover the mechanical bulk so that what is LEFT is small enough for a hand to answer honestly — and what is left here is two dissolutions, which is exactly the set that needs a human to say where the intent went.

THE UNIT IS THE (ADDRESS, TICKET) PAIR, AND THE TICKET SAID 'ADDRESS' EVERYWHERE. A forwarding order is one TICKET's record, so the same address is legitimately answered under one ticket and unanswered under another — cairn/chart/intention+why.json resolves under watchme-emits-a-probe's hand order and not at all for a claimless packet. Two hypotheses were KILLED on this one cause: both counted address occurrences, and address-level accounting can never close. The residue instrument had to be rebuilt around the pair before its numbers meant anything.

THE TWO DISSOLUTIONS THE CAST PREDICTED ARE ONE DISSOLUTION AT FIVE ADDRESSES. Counting events by address overcounts them. chart's twelve proofs went to eleven destinations — ten under builder/machines/<stage>/proofs, one each to tools/chain, tools/tree and skills/moreabout — so no plurality exists and the derivation correctly declines. skills/chart is the successor for the COMPONENT because its charter moved there whole; that is a fact only a hand holds, which is the hand door's whole reason to exist.

PLURALITY OVER UNANIMITY WAS MEASURED, NOT CHOSEN. 67 of base's 71 addresses answer under a strict-majority plurality against 64 under unanimity, and the three unanimity lost voted 6-1-1, 9-1 and 9-1. A bulk move is never unanimous — the stragglers move separately, later, in their own commits — so unanimity is a rule that reds precisely on the case the ticket was cast for.

THE MUTATION FOUND A TOOTH THE REVIEW HAD PASSED. Tooth (c) — 'a live address is never forwarded' — stayed green with the live-address guard deleted outright, because the fixture asked about a rename TARGET, which has no chain to follow: it was measuring git's silence rather than the resolver's refusal. Reading the proof could not see this; inverting the implementation could. The fixture now brings a name back from the dead. 6 of 6 seeded cases red on their own tooth and nothing else's.

THE THREE-WAY DECOMPOSITION IS THE MEASUREMENT, NOT THE BEFORE/AFTER. A single before/after cannot say which door did the work, so each door was disabled in turn: no door 362 findings across 9 components; hand door only 264 across 6; both doors 6 across 2; both doors plus the dissolution named by a hand, 0. Every per-sieve and per-component bucket falls monotonically. The cast's 82%/90% estimate was in the right neighbourhood for the wrong reason — it estimated over addresses.

WHAT IS LEFT IS NOT A HAND'S DEBT. Residue closed 17 pairs → 4, and the four are ONE claimless orient packet: a packet naming no ticket has no ticket whose forwarding order could answer for it. That is a structural floor of the pair-unit design, not an unwritten order, and it is owed its own ticket rather than an entry in someone's table.

THERE IS NO INTAKE DOOR FOR A TICKET'S `forwarding` FIELD. The thirteen hand entries that closed the dissolution were written by direct JSON edit across twelve tickets — one fact duplicated twelve times, with nothing checking either end at write time. The build checks both ends at READ time, which is why the entries are honest; nothing makes the next one honest.

workflow_and_state: code-seam@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> WATCHME(the_derivation_keeps_up_with_the_corpus) -> [PROVED] (cast 2026-08-14 by hand; re-fired through skills/sorted/door.py on 2026-08-17, which is what caught the objectless WATCHME the hand had written; PROVED 2026-08-17 through cairn.devices.harbor_master.clearance.clear — the first crossing in build_inspector's history to carry a clearance witness, the last PROVED (seq 43, 2026-08-07) predating the gate)

watchme.trigger: On any build_inspector sweep: fires when the reorg residue is non-empty beyond the hand-named dissolutions — i.e. when some address a berthed packet charted resolves neither in the world, nor through git's transitive rename record, nor through a directory plurality, nor through a hand-authored forwarding order. Fires ALSO when the derivation resolves an address to a target that does not exist on disk (wrong-intent clause 3) and when the rename record read zero renames (the vacuous scan — 444 records today, and a reading of 0 means the instrument stopped working, not that the corpus stopped moving).
watchme.enough: ASYMMETRIC, and the asymmetry is the ticket's falsifier. ONE derived forward whose target does not exist, or one address the derivation claims to have resolved that a later sieve still reds, is STRONG FALSIFICATION and satisfies alone — a tolerance that launders a broken address is worse than the red it replaced, because a red is distrusted by construction and a green tolerance is leaned on. CONFIRMATION is weak and needs THREE non-vacuous sweeps at zero-residue-beyond-the-hand-named, AT LEAST ONE OF THEM TAKEN AFTER A BULK MOVE — because a derivation that has never seen the corpus move is the misaimed census this system has already met once, and the whole claim is that it keeps up. A vacuous reading (zero rename records read) counts toward neither.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against THIS ticket's falsifier, carrying the two numbers gate (4) demands — addresses resolved by derivation, and the residue with each member named — so the residue is a list a hand can answer rather than a count a reader can round down.
watchme.consumer: build_inspector, which owns the sieves the tolerance feeds and is the component that re-opens this node when the intention stops working (Law 6 — the probe deposits and pokes, and carries no authority).

intent_berth: none, because this is a bug: the forwarding mechanism exists and is being asked to do something a hand cannot keep up with, and editing lines of code fixes it (ruling 2026-08-02, three entry points). The INVARIANT question inside it is not a bug and is not filed here as one — it is asked, and it stands at Akien's gate.
